motivation: A shared readout with 17 coefficients, trained on single real routes from original memory experts, transferred a roughly one-percentage-point all-four advantage to new bodies. Test whether conduct through an actual recurrent motor pathway can use that learned evidence, and whether developmental training can eventually do without it.
interface: Use the first predeclared live training seed 643793 at 4000, with no selection by test scores. Each candidate produces two actual sequential native motor responses under its two public polarities. Score each pair with the fixed four-unit network. During the five reaction ticks of the two-candidate menu, inject +tanh((score_R-score_L)/2) into existing right motor neuron 11 and the negative into existing left motor neuron 10. The full recurrent graph advances normally; its actual final motor difference selects the side. No externally prescribed action, no access to object truth, no new body nodes. The fine-scale scorer uses four transient motor observations plus a fixed learned precursor; it is an added afferent signal.
arms: Start all three arms from the identical previously repaired mixed-credit bodies in both cohorts. Attached: the learned current is active throughout. Fade: current strength 1 through update 1500, decreases linearly to zero at 4500, then stays off through 6000. Unassisted: exactly the same sensory scans, mode, menu and clocks with zero current throughout. All inherited body weights, biases and native local rule coefficients are updated from truly earned resources. The precursor weights stay fixed and were fitted on a disjoint original cohort development phase. Equal mixtures of paid training endpoints: every block of four has two genuine active four-object review lives, one ordinary short life and one mixed, seven-support life with two actual terminal actions that must both succeed. All body and trace states carry across contacts within each life.
test: Predeclare steps 0, 3000, 6000. Sampled four-object mean and all-correct outcomes versus actual siblings of the same graph, with/without input current, with donor current from a privately different history, and transfer just the donated side to the unmodified recipient. Evaluate old short, mixed context/mark, six-way and actual two-action earnings. To call the signal internalized, the withdrawn arm must outperform the equally trained unassisted arm in a zero-current deployment; any improvement that requires the readout must be reported as such. New common held-out geometry seeds 4219643/4219661, 256 active geometries per cohort.
